title: Work calendars
description: Review calendar entries and the employees assigned to each calendar.
oneCalendar: Each employee can use one work calendar.
bulkHint: Selections apply to every employee in the department or group.
moveHint: Selecting an employee currently assigned elsewhere moves that employee to this calendar.
helpIntro: Public holidays are imported automatically from the Cabinet Office when a calendar is created. Refresh holidays manually synchronizes them again for the year of the calendar currently displayed, such as when holidays for a future year are published or an official holiday is corrected.
helpRecords: Public holiday records for the displayed calendar year only
helpNames: Holiday names and holiday styling in calendars for that year
helpStats: Annual holidays, working days, and working hours
helpOtherYears: Calendars for other years are not changed.
helpShared: Calendars in the same year share the same public holiday data.
helpCompany: Company-specific days off are added separately as Company holiday entries.
helpOverride: A Working day entry overrides a public holiday for that calendar.
helpFailure: If the refresh fails, the existing holiday data is kept.

entrySaveFailed: Unable to save the calendar entry.
entryDeleteFailed: Unable to delete the calendar entry.
clickDate: Click a date to add or edit an entry.
createdWithHolidays: Calendar created and public holidays for {1} imported.
importRetry: {1} The calendar was created successfully; use Refresh holidays to try again.
deleteConfirm: Delete {1}? Employee assignments will be cleared.
